summary: scripts/ci-local runs fleet compatibility after the tests stage instead of alongside it; clippy still runs alongside. Fleet compatibility's cargo test -p fractal resolves features apart from the workspace build and relinked fractal-fixture in the shared build directory while nextest was running it, so tests that exec'd it failed with ETXTBSY and failed linux-gate (see #4128). A linux-gate run takes about as long as fleet compatibility does (300 s in the run that showed the race) longer than with both alongside.

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: The same stages run with the same commands; only fleet compatibility's place in time changes. The exit status is still the first failure's in the order given.

compatibility.detail: The stage table and the stage logs are as before; fleet compatibility's output is printed in the foreground, in its order, instead of after the lane.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; CI_LOCAL_SERIAL=1 still runs every stage one after another.
